documentation.path_semantics: full path of file to watch; exit list only
documentation.dir: full directory path; recursive subtree watch; exit list only
documentation.perm: may be used without a syscall; kernel selects syscalls satisfying requested permissions
documentation.permission_r: read access requested; open flags are inspected
documentation.permission_w: write access requested; open flags are inspected
documentation.direct_read_write_omission: direct read/write calls are omitted because they overwhelm logs
documentation.legacy_watch: -w is backward-compatible; syscall-form path/dir is more expressive

r6_design.path_scope: one exact pre-created file per logical host
r6_design.process_scope: one exact live post-exec child pid
